environment.storage: OS temporary directory, warm OS caches, buffered writes; no fsync
environment.network: HTTP/1.1 TCP_NODELAY loopback; no TLS/proxy/cloud; app-paced 64 KiB writes
environment.content: deterministic distinct repeated-byte entities; identity coding, no compression
environment.cpu_scope: process includes loopback servers; worker and caller thread CPU reported separately
environment.isolation: shared developer machine; no CPU affinity, load isolation or frequency lock

registry_release_gate: BLOCKED: two pinned actual registries and authorized storage redirect not run
legacy_baseline: Separate end-to-end singular loops; original transport, no fabricated pooled stats
